name: FlashInfer: Kernel Library for LLM Serving
notes: FlashInfer is a kernel library for LLM serving. Inspired by FlashAttention, vLLM, stream-K, CUTLASS, AITemplate. Provides attention kernels, MoE support, JIT compilation, profiling tools. 6.5k stars. Used by vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, TGI, MLC-LLM, LightLLM, lorax, ScaleLLM. Paper: arXiv:2501.01005.
